FY26 Store Operations Goals.stockout_prevention: Escalate likely stockouts above medium risk before the next delivery cutoff.

Training Completion Operating Standard.guidance: Protected training shifts should not be converted to service coverage except during approved emergency coverage windows.
peak_coverage_fallback_options: Use the StoreTime district schedule and partner availability view to identify an available cross-trained partner or shift lead from a nearby store, then ask the district scheduler to assign that coverage for the rush window.
Schedule an additional rush-window floor coverage shift in StoreTime so the training-coded partner can stay in training.
If coverage still cannot be secured, rebook the training block to a lower-demand window in the same week and mark the original conversion reason.
Escalate repeat misses if training utilization remains below 90% or the store is two or more weeks behind target.

Inventory Stockout Escalation Playbook.guidance: For high-risk ingredient stockouts, create an OpsTask for expedited transfer or vendor escalation.

Pacific Region Weekly Review Playbook.guidance: Briefings should prioritize high-severity risks and include evidence and recommended actions.
